description: This file implements a WebSocket-based real-time speech-to-text service for AssemblyAI, including connection management, message handling, and transcription processing.

classes.name: AssemblyAISTTService
classes.description: A service class for real-time speech-to-text using AssemblyAI's WebSocket API, handling connection, message parsing, and transcription streaming.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AssemblyAI STT service with API key, language, endpoint URL, connection parameters, and VAD options.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech-to-text process, establishing connection and preparing for audio streaming.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech-to-text process and disconnects from the WebSocket.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, sending chunks over WebSocket.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles VAD frames and triggers metrics or endpoint commands.

methods.name: _trace_transcription
methods.description: Records transcription events for tracing purposes.

methods.name: _build_ws_url
methods.description: Constructs the WebSocket URL with query parameters.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message receiving task.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Terminates WebSocket connection, sends termination message, and cleans up.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Creates the WebSocket connection to AssemblyAI.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises error if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from WebSocket.

methods.name: _parse_message
methods.description: Parses raw message dict into specific message class.

methods.name: _handle_message
methods.description: Dispatches WebSocket messages to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: _handle_termination
methods.description: Handles termination message, sets event, and pushes EndFrame.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Processes transcription results, pushes frames, and traces.
